# rainbird-ai (Rainbird Python SDK)

> Python SDK (`pip install rainbird-ai`, import `rainbird_ai`) for the Rainbird decision-intelligence REST API: start sessions against a knowledge map, inject facts, query relationships, answer the engine's questions (First Form yes/no, Second Form Object/Subject, plural, skip, certainty), read results with `certainty` and `fact_id`, walk evidence trees, fetch natural-language explanations, and read/create knowledge maps from RBLang. Sync (`Rainbird`/`Session`) and async (`AsyncRainbird`/`AsyncSession`) clients, a keyless `engine_version()`/`async_engine_version()` health check, typed frozen dataclasses (`is_question`/`is_result` are `Literal`-typed so branching narrows `QueryResponse` under mypy), a single exception hierarchy under `RainbirdError`, and a `rainbird` CLI. Python >= 3.10; runtime dependencies are httpx and anyio.

Start with AGENTS.md if you are writing code that uses the SDK; it contains the full public API, the question-answer protocol rules, and a list of common mistakes.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Self-contained reference for coding agents using the SDK: install, CLI notes (option placement, exit codes), canonical decision loop, every public method and model, exceptions, question protocol and value coercion rules, answerer contract, evidence, retries and idempotency, undocumented map endpoints, common mistakes.
- [README.md](README.md): Human-oriented overview, installation, quick start and usage examples.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history and breaking changes.

## Source

- [src/rainbird_ai/__init__.py](src/rainbird_ai/__init__.py): Public exports (`Rainbird`, `Session`, `AsyncRainbird`, `AsyncSession`, `engine_version`, `async_engine_version`, `SKIP`, `UNSET`, models, errors, `RetryPolicy`, `NO_RETRY`, `__version__`). `NoActiveSessionError` no longer exists.
- [src/rainbird_ai/client.py](src/rainbird_ai/client.py): Sync `Rainbird` (start/resume/version/evidence/evidence_url/get_map_source/create_map) and `Session` (inject/query/answer/skip/respond/undo/run/evidence/evidence_tree/iter_evidence_tree/interactions/knowledge_map/facts/interact/explain), plus module-level `engine_version(base_url=None, *, engine=None, timeout=UNSET, http_client=None)` which calls `GET /version` without an API key.
- [src/rainbird_ai/aio.py](src/rainbird_ai/aio.py): `AsyncRainbird` and `AsyncSession`, same API with `await`; `run()` accepts sync or async answerers; `async_engine_version()` is the keyless version check for `httpx.AsyncClient` users.
- [src/rainbird_ai/models.py](src/rainbird_ai/models.py): Frozen dataclasses for every payload (`Question`, `QuestionResponse`, `ResultResponse`, `ResultItem`, `Evidence`, `Rule`, `Condition`, `InteractResponse`, ...), `Environment` hosts, `QuestionForm`, `FactSource`, `studio_url_for()`, `parse_query_response()`; each model keeps the original JSON in `.raw`. `QuestionResponse.is_question`/`ResultResponse.is_result` are typed `Literal[True]`/`Literal[False]` so `if response.is_question:` narrows the `QueryResponse` union under mypy.
- [src/rainbird_ai/_answers.py](src/rainbird_ai/_answers.py): Pure question/answer protocol rules: `build_answers()`, `build_skip()`, `SKIP`, value coercion (`date`/`datetime` -> `YYYY-MM-DD`, integral `Decimal` -> `int`, enum -> `.value` (for yes/no and truth answers too), truth -> JSON boolean for Second Form Object answers only; `None`/dict/list/NaN/infinity -> `InvalidAnswerError`), option matching when `canAdd` is false (truth-typed Second Form Object answers by boolean; an exact string match keeps the caller's value; a purely numeric match for a numeric answer, number-typed question or numeric option sends the option's own value; otherwise `InvalidAnswerError`; all-`invalidResponse` concepts leave validation to the API), plural/allowUnknown validation, `Fact`/`Answer`/dict/tuple payload normalisation (`unanswered` must be bool-like).
- [src/rainbird_ai/_ops.py](src/rainbird_ai/_ops.py): One request builder per API endpoint (URL, headers such as `Version: v1`, body, response parser) shared by the sync and async clients, including the undocumented `/analysis/file/{kmID}` and `/maps` endpoints.
- [src/rainbird_ai/_http.py](src/rainbird_ai/_http.py): httpx transports (redirects never followed; async back-off via `anyio.sleep`), `RetryPolicy` (GET retried on transport errors and 429/500/502/503/504 (`retry_statuses`); POST only on 429/503, never on 502/504 or transport errors because a replayed `POST /response` could answer twice), the `UNSET` timeout sentinel, config resolution from env vars (`RAINBIRD_API_KEY`, `RAINBIRD_API_URL`, ...) with case-insensitive header merging, HTTP status/body to exception mapping (HTML error bodies tag-stripped and truncated; non-JSON 2xx -> `UnexpectedResponseError`).
- [src/rainbird_ai/errors.py](src/rainbird_ai/errors.py): Exception hierarchy rooted at `RainbirdError` (`RainbirdAPIError` and its 400/401/403/404/429/5xx subclasses, transport errors, `InvalidAnswerError`, `KnowledgeMapError`, `NaturalLanguageError`, ...).
- [src/rainbird_ai/cli.py](src/rainbird_ai/cli.py): `rainbird` command-line tool (version, start, inject, query, respond, undo, evidence, explain, interact, facts, session, interactions, map get/create). Global options may precede or follow the subcommand; `version` needs no API key; exit codes 0 success, 1 API/SDK/file error, 2 usage error, 3 question pending with no input available, 130 interrupted.
- [tests/conftest.py](tests/conftest.py): In-memory fake of the Rainbird API served through `httpx.MockTransport`, with canned question/result/evidence payloads; useful as a reference for exact wire formats.

## Examples

- [examples/basic_query.py](examples/basic_query.py): Start a session, query a relationship, answer questions interactively, print results.
- [examples/automated_answerer.py](examples/automated_answerer.py): Drive a decision to completion with `session.run()` and an answerer callback that returns `True` for First Form questions, the first option for Second Form questions with options, `SKIP` when `allow_unknown` is set and otherwise raises; comments mark where plural (list) answers and an LLM call would go.
- [examples/async_query.py](examples/async_query.py): The same decision loop with `AsyncRainbird` / `AsyncSession`.
- [examples/evidence_tree.py](examples/evidence_tree.py): Fetch a result's evidence, walk the full evidence tree and print rule bindings and conditions, plus the Studio evidence URL.
- [examples/inject_and_query.py](examples/inject_and_query.py): Inject known facts (tuples, dicts, `Fact`) in batches before querying so fewer questions are asked.
- [examples/natural_language.py](examples/natural_language.py): Beta `/nl/interact` and `/nl/explain` usage, including handling error responses without exceptions.
- [examples/create_map_from_rblang.py](examples/create_map_from_rblang.py): Create a knowledge map from RBLang with the undocumented `/maps` endpoint, then read its source back.

## External

- [Rainbird docs for LLMs](https://docs.rainbird.ai/llms.txt): Index of the Rainbird documentation in llms.txt format.
- [Developer docs overview](https://docs.rainbird.ai/rainbird/developer-docs/overview): Entry point for the Rainbird API documentation.
- [API request flow](https://docs.rainbird.ai/rainbird/developer-docs/api-guide/api-request-flow): Start, inject, query, response and undo walkthrough.
- [Example API requests](https://docs.rainbird.ai/rainbird/developer-docs/api-guide/example-api-requests): Example request and response payloads for each decision endpoint.
- [API keys and publishing](https://docs.rainbird.ai/rainbird/knowledge-modelling/publishing-your-km/api-management): Where API, evidence and interaction keys come from.
- [Knowledge modelling overview](https://docs.rainbird.ai/rainbird/knowledge-modelling/overview): Concepts, relationships, rules and RBLang.
- [OpenAPI reference](https://rainbird.redoc.ly/): Rendered OpenAPI 3.1 specification of the Rainbird API (decisions, evidence, natural language, platform endpoints).
